sources.title: Building a 75,000-Product Image Feature Dataset for the Amazon ML ...
sources.snippet: Hey everyone! Hope you're all doing great today. So I've got something pretty exciting to share with you all — I just created a massive image features dataset for the Amazon ML Challenge 2025! Processing 75,000 product images and extracting deep learning features was absolutely wild. I never thought I'd be building ML-ready datasets at this scale — but here we are!
